Iceberg or EXHAUSTION? Who really stopped the move 🧊

A selloff can stop for two opposite reasons. An iceberg is a hidden passive buyer: huge volume at one price, far above what the DOM displays, and price can't trade through it. Exhaustion is the absence of sellers: volume dries up at the low with tiny prints. They look the same on a candle chart, but they are different trades.

1️⃣ Big volume at one price, no progress = iceberg (defended level)
2️⃣ Traded size far above displayed size on the DOM = hidden order refilling
3️⃣ Tiny volume at the extreme = exhaustion (weak low, often revisited)
4️⃣ In both cases wait for delta to flip and price to reclaim the level
